component.name: Driveclub-PC
component.summary: Run your own Driveclub PS4 dump on Linux

description.p: A shadPS4-based emulator tuned for Driveclub CUSA00093 with update 1.28. Includes a settings launcher, Vulkan rendering and SDL controller support. Your own game and PS4 firmware dumps are required and are not included.
Gameplay compatibility and performance depend on your hardware, graphics driver and game dump.
Linux hybrid CPU scheduling fix and persistent presentation settings.
